scope: same fixed original best weights, full-only replay; no training or sampled-effect-based tuning
fixed_F: original matching-best native FP32 points and complete query-key ranks, shared unchanged across every shard

basis.zero_change_requirements: complete hit fractions, direct/distant order, pair signs, ties and unresolved fractions remain unchanged

limit_rule: four times observed GPU-vs-original-F maximum; positive continuous values rounded upward to one significant digit; integer counts/rank deltas rounded upward to integer; zero observations remain zero
qualification: All v1 exact identities, native point, geodesic, complete rank count/max, hits, and hierarchy hard gates remain. Original absolute micro/macro MRR limits are reported v1 diagnostics only; signed query contributions retained. Original F remains fixed.
limitations: seed11 observed errors and fourfold engineering margins are not statistical confidence bounds or guaranteed numerical upper bounds
seed23 is an independent frozen-policy replay check; rejection triggers diagnosis without automatically enlarging limits
full-control error budgets do not guarantee numerical bounds on sampled graphs or define statistical null equivalence bands
report measured full repeat errors alongside sampling effect sizes; tiny significant effects do not automatically establish substantive hierarchy/task damage
original c2 bit-exact failures remain failed historical records; successful amended qualification is a separate result
v2 MRR is a reporting/sensitivity outcome, not a full-control hard limit; original v1 rejection remains unchanged and v2 cannot guarantee sampled-graph numerical error.

The v2 retrieval interpretation requires two negative Holm-significant primary/sensitivity MRR effects that each exceed the modelwise observed full-control drift maximum; non-significant agreement is not damage evidence.
supersedes: Separately versioned full-only qualification admission after preserved v1 seed11-r4 failure; no data/model/training/selection/sampling/statistical-math change. Old v1 artifacts and failures retain original status and source.

rank_sensitive_amendment.sensitivity_rule: For every sample keep the original S-original-F primary contrast and complete Holm12 family. Also subtract that shard full-control signed micro-MRR drift from S-F and recompute the same complete Holm12; direct-order entries stay unchanged. Report both. A robust retrieval-damage claim requires both original and adjusted means negative, both Holm decisions reject, and both absolute means exceed the modelwise maximum observed absolute full-control drift. If sign or Holm decision changes, no robust retrieval-damage claim. Modelwise observed maxima include the frozen seed11 three-complete-rank v1 basis, the preserved failed v1 seed11-r4 full control, both accepted full-only replays, and every saved shard full control. Full-control observations are not independent graph repeats and maxima are not guaranteed error bounds.
